questions.question: Choose the word nearest in meaning to candid.
Hardly had he arrived blank the rain started. Which word fits?
Choose the word opposite in meaning to obscure.
questions.explanation: Obscure means unclear, so its opposite is clear.

questions.question: Life is a journey. What figure of speech is this?
questions.explanation: It says life is a journey without using like or as. That is a metaphor.

questions.question: If I blank you, I would apologise. Which word fits?
questions.explanation: In a wish or an imagined situation we say if I were you.

questions.question: What does the idiom to bury the hatchet mean?
questions.explanation: To bury the hatchet means to make peace.

questions.question: In she spoke softly, which word is the adverb?
questions.explanation: Softly tells us how she spoke. It is an adverb.

questions.question: Each of the students blank a book. Which word fits?
questions.explanation: Each takes a singular verb: each of the students has a book.

questions.question: What is the plural of criterion?
He is good blank mathematics. Which word fits?
questions.explanation: We are good at a subject.
